title: Keep the galleries open late on Thursdays
body:
# Keep the galleries open late on Thursdays

## Context
Visitors who work office hours could rarely reach the galleries before closing.

## Decision
On Thursdays the galleries stay open until nine, and the cafe serves until eight. Entry after five is by the side door on Mill Lane.

## Consequences
Two extra attendants cover each Thursday evening. School groups keep their weekday morning slots.
